response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaingb, AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT g.zoneref, g.insurstat, g.avg_remaingb, g.avg_cpu_gpu_gap, g.avg_remaingb / m.mean_avg AS ratio FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
